2821.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?
2821.text1: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

2824.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.
2824.text1: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2825.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.
2825.text1: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

2828.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.
2828.text1: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

3003.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.
3003.text1: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

3172.text: Salutations.  My function is to offer access to and, when permissible, insight into information regarding the Creators' synthesis of the Earthen on the world designated as Azeroth.  I am ready to share this information with you now at your leisure.

3173.text: The Earthen are a synthesized race engineered by the Creators, functioning as one of the seed races in the initial population of the world designated as Azeroth.  The Earthen were created to aid the Creators' efforts in shaping the deep regions of this world.$B$BThey are a modification of the standard subterranean being matrix used on other worlds that the Creators have seeded.  The construction of this prototype race created various anomalies that were observed after initial synthesis.

3174.text: It is one of the synthesis matrices the Creators use when seeding a world.  Each synthesis matrix is used to achieve the Creators' goals.  For Azeroth, a subterranean being matrix was modified to create a being with increased durability with an affinity for deep region shaping; the Earthen are the product of this modification.$B$BAfter the Earthen had been put into service for the Creators, unforeseen anomalies were discovered that affected their synthesis matrix due to high-stress environments.

3175.text: Additional background information on the Earthen must be given to you before this question may be answered properly.$B$BProcessing.$B$BTo understand the anomalies of the Earthen, it is first important to understand what the Earthen represent in their design intent.  The Earthen represent the Creators' attempt at improving the survivability paradigm of the standard subterranean being matrix.  This was done by incorporating a resilient foundation of construction inherent to the world into said matrix.

3176.text: It is the baseline material used in race synthesis.  A cross-section of Azeroth's crust was used as the foundation for the Earthen's synthesis rather than the typical biomass construction foundation used by the Creators.$B$BResearch on the world's composition led the Creators to theorize that an enhanced being could be synthesized that would epitomize the resiliency of this world's essence.  This was accomplished by choosing to use a blend of Azeroth's various stone core compounds as the foundation.

3177.text: Simply stated, this is correct.$B$BThe Earthen's physical features are that of a smaller stature humanoid, though their composition is that of Azeroth's various stone core compounds.  Their design maximizes strength and stamina without sacrificing cognitive processing power.  Their skin and musculature are nearly impervious to physical damage, and with very minor modifications the Earthen display a remarkable resiliency to unwanted magical forces.

3178.text: It is integral to the assimilation of this data that it is understood that the Creators wanted to synthesize a race that would long be an integral part of this world's development cycle after they had departed.  This race would be instrumental in fulfilling the Creators' long-term development objectives for Azeroth.  $B$BAs an ancillary note, the nomenclature "Earthen" was deemed apropos for the new race by the Creators, based on the Earthen's composition.

3179.text: The Earthen's only anomaly in synthesis is the tendency for matrix destabilization while being utilized in high-stress environments.$B$BAddendum: deep earth sculpting was naturally suited to the new matrix design and thus never met the qualifications of duplicating a high-stress environment.$B$BDestabilization was not discovered until well into the Earthen's primary service cycle for the Creators.  The Creators began work on post-synthesis modification, rather than recall and re-synthesis.

3180.text: [There is a noticeable pause after you ask this question.]$B$BThe information you request is not currently available in this repository's data cycling.  I sincerely apologize for this omission.$B$BPlease request this information after a data cycling update has been performed on this information repository.  You may also request this information from another information repository located on Azeroth.

3181.text: There are two potential results when the Earthen's synthesis matrix destabilizes.  Initiating visual aid representation number one.$B$BThe first variant matrix is a degenerative product of synthesis, hereby designated with the common nomenclature of "Trogg".  This variant maintains strength and stamina comparable to the Earthen, but its cognitive processing power has been almost completely compromised.  Force of will and a strong sense of cunning are the only driving factors in the psyche of the trogg.

3182.text: I am unable to process your chronological reference in comparison to the recording of this data, my apologies.$B$BThe trogg retains some composition of Azeroth's various stone core compounds, but the loss of cognitive power makes this variant unacceptable to the Creators.$B$BThe trogg procreates as per a standard biomass.  By default it consumes stone and anything else it can acquire, including other troggs.  Cannibalism is considered unacceptable by the Creators.

3183.text: Initiating visual aid representation number two.$B$BThe second resultant variance of the Earthen matrix retains many desired elements when compared to the standard subterranean matrix.  The common nomenclature for this variant is "Dwarf".$B$BThis variant retains strength and stamina inherent to the Earthen.  In some cases, the dwarf even exceeds the cognitive powers of the Earthen's matrix.  The dwarf, however, retains none of the physical composition of Azeroth's various stone core compounds.

3184.text: The data stored in this repository does indeed correlate with your astute proclamation.$B$BThe dwarf maintains an affinity for the stone composition of Azeroth, but due to the high-stress environmental anomaly within the Earthen's synthesis matrix, the dwarf reverts to a default biomass composition as seen in the standard subterranean matrix.$B$BErgo, the dwarf variant does synthesize from the degeneration of the Earthen creation matrix, as you inferred with your query.

3185.text: I am unable to process your chronological reference in comparison to the recording of this data, my apologies.$B$BThough the dwarf maintains most of the Earthen's mental attunement to Azeroth's stone composition, the reversion back into living biomass remains the main degeneration of the matrix.  Dwarves eat and procreate through means typical to other standard biomasses.$B$BThe Creators view the dwarf as an acceptable variant, worthy of genesis in its own right.

3186.text: The Creators are... the Creators.$B$BThey are the beings that seeded and shaped this world by their own design.  They are the reason for this world's existence, as well as many other worlds.  They are the wellspring from which Azeroth flows.

3187.text: The Creators are cognizant of the magnitude of the information housed in this repository.  Subsequently, a portable copy of the data stored here will be made available to you once you are attuned with the Discs of Norgannon.$B$BPlease consider your cursory requirements for the assimilation of this knowledge to be complete.  At your leisure, access the Discs of Norgannon to begin synthesis of your discs.

3376.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?
3376.text1: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

3378.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?
3378.text1: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

3397.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!
3397.text1: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

3405.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us $g sir : ma'am;?
3405.text1: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us $g sir : ma'am;?

3407.text: Where is it ye would like to go $g lad : lass;? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.
3407.text1: Where is it ye would like to go $g lad : lass;? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

3408.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.
3408.text1: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3581.text: It's hard to imagine that so much death and despair could be confined to such a small area; yet beyond the swamp is a land plagued by chaos and destruction.$B$BWatch your step, adventurer. The Blasted Lands are the final resting place to far greater beings than you.

3583.text: Thrall's Grasp they called us: Twenty of Thrall's most accomplished and honored soldiers.$B$BI had ordered the regiment to build an encampment here, on the border of the Blasted Lands, while we waited for our orders to arrive from Orgrimmar. Weeks passed without word from the warchief; the men grew restless.$B$BIt was a judgment call, $n. I was young and ambitious, afraid of nothing. The battalion would set forth into the Blasted Lands under my command.$B$BA decision I would later regret.

3602.text: Regret. It is all I have now. One bad decision resulting in several horrible outcomes. If only I had waited for those orders. Maybe they would have detailed the horrors that awaited us in those cursed lands! Maybe they were to redirect us to another detail? Ultimately, it was my fault. All of it was my fault.

3801.text: Help!$B$BIf you get me out of here, I can blow up the door that leads to the chief of Zul'Farrak!

3804.text: Thanks, $n.  If you hadn't shown up I'm sure we would have been dead meat!  Now the only thing between us and the chief troll is that door yonder...

3808.text: Thanks a lot, $n.  We couldn't have made it without you.  Oh, and if I had mentioned before something about repaying you for saving us, well... you can forget it!

4005.text: Eraka no Kimbul$BGod of Tigers, Lord of Beasts, King of Cats, the Prey's Doom$B$BUeetay no Mueh'zala$BGod of Death, Father of Sleep, Son of Time, the Night's Friend.

4007.text: Elortha no Shadra$BGod of Spiders, Mother of Venom, Silk Dancer, Death's Love.

4179.text: Incredible power can be found in the spirits or "muisek" of the creatures that we battle against.$B$BLook inside yourself; learn to harness the power of your own spirit, and you will be more powerful than you ever imagined.

4182.text: Sul'thraze... the first time I heard the word uttered I was around your age. It meant nothing to me then, as it means nothing to you now. It was not until a warband of trolls coming from Zul'Farrak laid waste to the land that I understood... and feared.$B$BMany will tell you that the Splitblade of Suffering does not exist. That it's a myth; a rumor started to scare children 'straight.' But believe me, $r, it exists.$B$B<Trenton loses focus as he runs his hand across the jagged scar on his face.>

4420.text: Existing in this area are many creatures considered allies of the night elves. The elves have had access to the power within each of these creatures; it is time that the horde be allowed this same satisfaction. I have devised a way that this power can be captured and used for our benefit.$B$BDo not doubt what I tell you, $n. Help me, and you shall see that I speak truth.

4423.text: If tailoring is your thing, Vizzklick will most definitely have your supplies. Take a look around, $n, and let me know if you wish to purchase something!

4512.text: This spirit hovers over its fallen body.  Its ghostly eyes pierce through you as it gazes beyond...

4565.text: Greetings, $c.  Though time and drink have dulled my outer senses, my inner eyes remain strong.

4617.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.
4617.text1: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

4619.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?
4619.text1: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

4621.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?
4621.text1: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

4632.text: Hello, $n! I am master engineer, Scooty.

4635.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.
4635.text1: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

4957.text: Welcome to Camp Mojache, brave $c.  How may I assist you this day?

5274.text: Welcome to Tanaris, $n. How can I be of service to you today? You don't look like a blacksmith to me, but I know how looks can be deceiving.

5520.text: Lady Sylvanas has ordered the investigation of some of the natural phenomena of Azeroth. She feels there is something great to be learned from its secretive past.$B$BI know not how she learned such things, but I trust her completely, so I will do my best.$B$BI am currently investigating slimes, oozes and such. The creatures all seem to be similar in make up, but greatly affected by their environment.$B$BI could use your help in gathering samples of the creatures..

5922.text: Listen to the stories of an elder. $n. I have many to speak of...

5983.text: Ah a visitor! Must be an adventurer, we don't get many tourists down this way. Grab a chair and a drink, make yourself comfortable. Say, you look like you have some meat on your bones. You thinkin about competing in the cage matches?
5983.text1: Ah a visitor! Must be an adventurer, we don't get many tourists down this way. Grab a chair and a drink, make yourself comfortable. Say, you look like you have some meat on your bones. You thinkin about competing in the cage matches?

6028.text1: Your errand must mean much, $c, to draw you so deep into the marsh...

6445.text: And a good day to ya, brave $c.  I know ya be lookin' for a fine steed.  There's no finer steed than a raptor under your reigns, lemme tell you $g mon : sis;!  Take a look at the ones I got to offer - bred from the fiercest stock anywhere.
6445.text1: And a good day to ya, brave $c.  I know ya be lookin' for a fine steed.  There's no finer steed than a raptor under your reigns, lemme tell you $g mon : sis;!  Take a look at the ones I got to offer - bred from the fiercest stock anywhere.

7057.text: The skinners usually take all their hides into Ironforge to dry out.  Why don't you head there and see if you can find one to train ye?
7057.text1: The skinners usually take all their hides into Ironforge to dry out.  Why don't you head there and see if you can find one to train ye?

7228.text: Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.$B$BOur great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

7376.text: $g Hey there cutie, you looking for a ride to Grom'gol? I hear it gets mighty steamy down in those jungles, maybe I could join you for a short vacation, show you a real jungle cat. : Come, take a trip to the wonderful, gorgeous, tropical jungles of Stranglethorn. That's right, you too can be spending your time sunbathing by the crystal blue waters while I stand here in this unbearable heat with nothing to look at but my brother Frezza all day! Enjoy your trip!;
7376.text1: $g Hey there cutie, you looking for a ride to Grom'gol? I hear it gets mighty steamy down in those jungles, maybe I could join you for a short vacation, show you a real jungle cat. : Come, take a trip to the wonderful, gorgeous, tropical jungles of Stranglethorn. That's right, you too can be spending your time sunbathing by the crystal blue waters while I stand here in this unbearable heat with nothing to look at but my brother Frezza all day! Enjoy your trip!;

7448.text: Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.$B$BWhile you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

7534.text: I can teach you the finer points of Raptor Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
7534.text1: I can teach you the finer points of Raptor Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

7624.text: This is a dangerous place, $n. Be careful around here.

7659.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?
7659.text1: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

7702.text: They called me stupid, but I'll show them. I'm going to watch every pot I have and prove that they can all boil stuff anyway. Yeah, I'm on a roll! Who's stupid now, huh? Huh!?

7710.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $n, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

7712.text: Your knowledge of potions has exceeded mine, but you still have much to learn. Go up the stairs to the southeast and see Doctor Marsh. He will teach you true sufferi--ahem. He is a Forsaken who will train you further.

7736.text: You're talking to the wrong orc. I don't train novices. Talk to young Whuut over there... and use small words.

7743.text1: When I first saw the undead, I wept, for I could not imagine their horror and loneliness. The Earth Mother spoke to me then; she sang in my blood. And she told me, "Save them."

7754.text: With Algernon to keep me supplied, I can do all my work here without hunting for a single herb. If I never have to see the wonders of nature again, it won't be too soon.

7758.text: Here to learn? Very well. I suppose you can't cause our allies much harm if I teach you. Just as long as you actually do manage to harm our enemies.

7765.text: Incredible. Your potions display a knowledge that rivals my own. I cannot train you further, but talk to the orc Rogvar of Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows. He's known for his cutting-edge experiments.

7768.text: Ready for training? Then try to keep up, $n. We've got a lot of ground to cover.

7829.text: Hmm... well, I can't help you quite yet! You have to learn the basics first. Why don't you go see Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind!

7834.text: You can learn from me in time... but not yet! Why don't you start out by talking to Sprite Jumpsprocket to my right here. You can check in with me after you've gotten your feet wet!

8057.text1: We cannot afford to give an inch in this war. Day and night, I create new armor, and I patch whatever can be salvaged from the old. I have no time for other tasks. Would you take care of something for me?

8080.text: We don't get many visitors out here. May I interest you in something?

8081.text: I'm just a student myself, really. Rhiannon's the expert. She's standing by the crates over there. You can learn a lot from her.

8082.text: Yes, I think you have potential. Maybe I can show you a thing or two.

8095.text: How may I be of service?

8104.text: Fastest gryphons this side of Aerie Peak. Want to take a ride?

8111.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

8116.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

8122.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

8151.text: About time you showed me some results! Now I'll show you results!

8182.text1: Good, you've got some grit! I like that. Well then, let's get going!

8260.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?
8260.text1: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

8264.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.
8264.text1: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

8293.text: $n, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?
8293.text1: $n, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

8344.text: We may have been suffering a drought but there's no shortage of meat! Care to browse my goods?

8406.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?
8406.text1: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

8695.text: Don't listen to the hearts of the world - the answer lies within.  You know the truth.

8873.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

8969.text: Greetings, $n. I am Doctor Gregory Victor, head trauma surgeon of Horde Trauma.

8970.text: It is good to see you again, Doctor $n. I have been following your progress and I dare say that it is time you learned some of the more advanced bandaging techniques.$B$BReturn to me from time to time, as your skill advances, and I shall teach you all that I know.

9030.text: You have learned all that I am able to teach you at this time, Doctor $n. Return to me when your practice has expanded and I shall train you in the ways of the more advanced medicinal arts.

9557.text: I can teach you fishing skills.
9557.text1: I can teach you fishing skills.

9685.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!
9685.text1: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

9686.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.
9686.text1: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

9687.text: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.
9687.text1: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

9816.text: Maybe this wasn't the best place for a shop after all...

9864.text: You scared the fish away!  What do you want?

9865.text: What can I do for you $c?

9975.text: I've got all the cooking supplies you'll ever need, mon!

10173.text: We must ensure the survival of this camp at all costs, $c!  Our enemies must not be given any quarter, for they would surely give us none were we to need it.

10174.text: These are dangerous times, $r.  An ancient evil is rising, and it cares not if you're Horde or Alliance.

10488.text: If you ask me, the best part about fishing is its slow pace.  It gives one time to think, to reflect on past events and to plan for future ones.$B$BOh, and it's also a great excuse to drink.  Heavily.

10622.text: You can't teach an old dog new tricks.  At least that's what someone once told me.  Lucky for you, I've discovered it to be untrue.$b$bHowever, pets do tend to get resistant to the technique, and I need more food each time to keep them happy.  What that means is that you'll owe me more money the more times I untrain the same pet.$b$bNow then, would you like me to start untraining?
10622.text1: You can't teach an old dog new tricks.  At least that's what someone once told me.  Lucky for you, I've discovered it to be untrue.$b$bHowever, pets do tend to get resistant to the technique, and I need more food each time to keep them happy.  What that means is that you'll owe me more money the more times I untrain the same pet.$b$bNow then, would you like me to start untraining?

10753.text: Where would you like to fly to?
10753.text1: Where would you like to fly to?

10863.text: War is upon us, $n.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

11154.text: Welcome to Booty Bay, partner.  I hope your stay in my town is enjoyable and uneventful - emphasis on the latter.  We've got plenty of drink if you're thirsty, and plenty of bouncers if you're antsy.$B$BNow then... what can this humble servant of the Steamwheedle Cartel do for you?  Better still - what can you do for me, eh?

212747.text: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.
212747.text1: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, ma'am. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.

212751.text: How perfect of you to come by, $c.$B$BMy name is Lotwil Veriatus, founding member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy, and Engineering Sciences: we seek to blend the intelligent sciences of Azeroth together into one comprehensive school.
212751.text1: How perfect of you to come by, $c.$B$BMy name is Lotwil Veriatus, founding member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy, and Engineering Sciences: we seek to blend the intelligent sciences of Azeroth together into one comprehensive school.

212752.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.
212752.text1: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

244595.text1: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

250597.text1: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

269614.text: <Nami is preoccupied, adjusting the viewfinder of the gigantic telescope.>
269614.text1: <Nami is preoccupied, adjusting the viewfinder of the gigantic telescope.>

276311.text: Impulse purchases are the most fun kind of purchases!
276311.text1: Impulse purchases are the most fun kind of purchases!

292961.text:
Professions are divided between two main categories: primary and secondary.

You are limited to a maximum of two primary professions at a time. You can abandon your skill in a primary profession at any time; however, the wealth of knowledge you gathered for it will be lost. If you choose to return to your original profession, you will need to train from the basics and seek out recipes you previously acquired to refamiliarize yourself with them.

Secondary professions do not have such a limit. These skills tend to err towards self-sufficiency with your basic survival needs. You are free to train any or all of these, but may find fewer opportunities to turn a profit.

296176.text:
I've got plenty to do around here, but there's always time for visitors interested in technology. The shop has certainly been more orderly than you see it now, but without my mentor Yaely around anymore I don't have anyone to nag me to pick up after myself. 

Ah... to go back to the pre-war days.

299683.text: Hail and well met, traveler.$B$BI wish my arrival was met with good tidings but the realm of Dalaran is in need of aid from the kingdoms of the Alliance.

299703.text:
Unfortunately, the rumor of our plight is true. Disruptions to our leylines have unveiled a disturbance amongst the arcane forces of our city.

With Dalaran on the cusp of reopening its borders to our allies, we are in dire need of immediate solutions.

300665.text1: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

301834.text: There won't be an explosion. The detonator I gave you was designed to fail.

301836.text: SI:7 will take things from here. The forge and warship you liberated from the Defias have strategic value and we are taking control of them.

301837.text1: You don't understand. That forge is poisoning the farms of Westfall! If it isn't destroyed, nothing will grow here for generations. You're risking a major famine!

301838.text: Thank you for your concern, elf, but this is now a Stormwind internal matter. Your help is no longer needed at this time.

302214.text:
The full story requires time that I suspect you do not have, so I will attempt to be brief.

Perhaps the simplest way I can put it: these crystals are anchors. They can be used to permanently--well, so long as the crystals hold I suppose--bind something, someone, or even somewhere onto our plane of Azeroth. Prince Tortheldrin ordered the creation of similar pylons when he chose to bind the demon Immol'thar. Some of the Shen'dralar protested this decision and proposed a compelling alternative, but ultimately the prince was uninterested in debate and eager to silence dissent.

I had an opportunity to study their design before it became too unsafe for me to stay within the city's walls and I fled back to Shen'dralas.

302215.text:
The proposed alternative to demonic entanglement was at odds with what Tortheldrin had already set in motion. Given that he was working with power that tends to cloud one's judgment, it's no surprise that his first instinct was to lash out.

Most everyone who pushed back against his plans to summon and bind a demon were slain that day. Some escaped, including some of my own kin that stood in opposition to the prince, but I have yet to meet other survivors of that schism even after all these thousands of years.

303452.text:
I am Toron Rockhoof, and I serve as the smith for all tasks here at the summit.

Recently, matters have become... tense. I do not usually involve myself in politics, but it seems that there is a good deal of mistrust. Several druids have left to join a new faction, following one who calls himself the Wild King.

If the other druids do not sort out their problems, they may not be able to keep the summit protected!

303703.text:
Mortal, thank you. The vitality within you gives me the will to reform what presence of myself I still recognize as my own.

Tormented for years with undeath, my entire existence was haunting these hills and shambling endlessly. Tracing back my history with you is gradually helping clear the cobwebs of this dusty memory.

The war raging across this mountain years ago took with it countless lives. The damage can't be quantified, but to think of what more misery could have yet still occurred if Archimonde, and not our forces, were victorious.
303703.text1:
Mortal, thank you. The vitality within you gives me the will to reform what presence of myself I still recognize as my own.

The war raging across this mountain years ago took with it countless lives. The damage can't be quantified, but to think of what more misery could have yet still occurred if Archimonde, and not our forces, were victorious.

303704.text:
In the midst of battle, you may see a glimpse of massacre about to happen, with a chance to stop it. A quick decision, an order shouted, an arrow released, a blow deflected. During the battle that raged across Mount Hyjal, strategic retreats are all we had to slow the advancing undead and allow our defenders more time to prepare.

Our barricades were starting to break, and our front line was close to being overrun. My childhood friend Tobin, who had been paired up with me ever since basic training, was positioned at an overlook tower over our established stronghold. I was supporting our flank, with our riflemen and siege engines.
303704.text1:
In the midst of battle, you may see a glimpse of massacre about to happen, with a chance to stop it. A quick decision, an order shouted, an arrow released, a blow deflected. During the battle that raged across Mount Hyjal, strategic retreats are all we had to slow the advancing undead and allow our defenders more time to prepare.

Our barricades were starting to break, and our front line was close to being overrun. My childhood friend Tobin, who had been paired up with me ever since basic training, was positioned at an overlook tower over our established stronghold. I was supporting our flank, with our riflemen and siege engines.

303705.text:
Our commanders behind us signaled for a retreat, so our forces began to rotate away from the front line, and towards the narrow chokepoint granting an escape path. A massive frost wyrm crested over the mountain...

<The war veteran pauses for a prolonged time.>

It's too dark there yet.

Tobin's presence in the battle is still blocked in my mind... I only have the good memories of our younger years bleeding back into my soul.

303706.text:
Tobin and I grew up together, getting into trouble, saving each other's backs. All sorts of landmarks have our initials carved upon them, or into a tree that shades its revelers.

There's a chance you can reignite something further if you can honor a place that was once significant to me in a moment of time.

304460.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.
304460.text1: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

304595.text1: As experienced as one might be, I urge you to travel with caution. These plains are home to ferocious beasts and others who seek to remove us from these lands. Even the skies have become too dangerous for our wyverns.

305021.text: You don't look like much, but something tells me you are right. I think I'll just sit here a bit longer. Thanks for the chat, stranger.
305021.text1: You don't look like much, but something tells me you are right. I think I'll just sit here a bit longer. Thanks for the chat, stranger.

305124.text1: Come to trade with the Barkskin, have you?

305554.text:
We are last of our kind. Barkskin still stand, with no rot like Deadwood. Yet same doom weigh on us. You folk think all furbolg foul.

Doubt makes hearts hard. My kin strike at all who come near, in fear of tricks.

But, you may walk soft, show true, grow trust. Prove self strong. Then Barkskin call you friend, not foe.
305554.text1:
We are last of our kind. Barkskin still stand, with no rot like Deadwood. Yet same doom weigh on us. You folk think all furbolg foul.

Doubt makes hearts hard. My kin strike at all who come near, in fear of tricks.

But, you may walk soft, show true, grow trust. Prove self strong. Then Barkskin call you friend, not foe.

305555.text:
You must find way to show you both fight same side. Barkskin may strike now, but if you stay strong, you will find ways.

Do not harm barkskin kin, or you lose all hope to make them friend.

Start with Deadwood. They roam much of Hyjal. Deadwood are foe of pure furbolg kin. Slay them, and Barkskin see you true.

307136.text:
This was once a part of Eldre'Thalas - the ancient city of my people that lies just over the southern mountains. Dire Maul, I believe it is commonly called these days. Perhaps you have heard of it.

Over time, the elements have worn away at our marvelous structures and smothered our gardens. I yearn to return to the halls of Eldre'Thalas, but I am still haunted by memories of the past.

For now, I am content merely watching over these lands and reminiscing over what once was.

307841.text:
Ah, it's been some time since we've had adventurers roam these halls. Welcome to Farholde Keep. Enjoy these comforts while you can. I'm sure you've seen the conditions we're forced to keep.

It seems every day we lose more of our home to the ever-growing infestation of Horde mongrels and Light-forsaken Twilight's Hammer cultists. With those cowards in Stormwind hiding behind their walls, we are forced to bring order to these beasts ourselves.

Perhaps you'd like to put some of those $c talents to use?

307855.text1: Greetings, $c. As advisor to Demar, I would be happy to answer any questions you have about Farholde Keep.

309779.text:
No fights goin' on today, pal. The Horde and the Alliance are too busy killin' each other out in the fields when there's perfectly good coin to be made doin' that in my arena! Go figure.

Come back when I get this place up and runnin'.

309803.text: I have seen your kind, like folk that make their homes above ours. Our fight is with the Deadwood, not you, one of short-claws.
309803.text1: I have seen your kind, like folk that make their homes above ours. Our fight is with the Deadwood, not you, one of short-claws.

309817.text: If you wish to learn, show us how you are here to help.
309817.text1: If you wish to learn, show us how you are here to help.

310113.text: Mount Hyjal's woods and eyes have much to teach. We have more to learn, and you the same.

310771.text: They are going to see somethin' really scary!

311268.text: In the northwestern mountain range of Azshara, due north of the Ruins of Eldarath, there is an old passage that leads into the heart of Blackmaw Hold.
311268.text1: In the northwestern mountain range of Azshara, due north of the Ruins of Eldarath, there is an old passage that leads into the heart of Blackmaw Hold.

311269.text: The Blackmaw tribe holds this stronghold as their home. If you are journeying into northern Azshara, be on your guard, as the Blackmaw tribe is wary of all strangers as many of their kin have fallen to corruption and the animosity that we show them is returned by the Blackmaw as a measure of safety.
311269.text1: The Blackmaw tribe holds this stronghold as their home. If you are journeying into northern Azshara, be on your guard, as the Blackmaw tribe is wary of all strangers as many of their kin have fallen to corruption and the animosity that we show them is returned by the Blackmaw as a measure of safety.

311483.text: Greetings, traveler. The road to Mount Hyjal is long and dangerous. You may rest in the shelter of this cave, if you wish. I am a friend to all who come in peace.

313610.text:
I'm inclined to agree. Despite our people coming together to survive the Great Sundering it seems as though the city was nonetheless doomed. How pedantic is it that its fall from grace would come from something so mundane as internal strife?

My loyalty was unquestionable in those days, but in the years since I've come to realize that the rebellion was the moment that we truly lost Prince Tortheldrin. Everything that came after is but a consequence of that wound upon his soul.
 
For my part, I try to avoid dwelling on the past, particularly my role in those events.

Try as I might though... it still haunts me.

313613.text:
Celebrating my own life as I stare toward the mass grave of so many of my kin feels... selfish. Many among my order remain cloistered in Prince Tortheldrin's inner sanctum, I suspect to hide from their own guilt. Seeing the city from this perspective makes it difficult to avoid painful truths.

I still count myself among the Shen'dralar, but these days I am long estranged from the library I once called home.

314339.text1:
For years our allies fought against the Scourge and demonic presence threatening the mountain. Though the days of battle have passed, Grimroot and I swore to protect against any remaining threats. With a small scourge presence just ahead, we'll remain here until they are no more.

When entering the nearby camp, do keep an eye out for Grim. He means well, but he's quite stubborn. Though the infection took most of his sight and strength he refuses to stop his patrols. Thick bark hides scars well.

I worry for him so.

314430.text: Look, if you want me to talk then you gotta do something for me, yeah?

314543.text1: Dem great battles come an' go. Now alls we left wit be da pains o' war and da cleanup needed to make sure none of them scourge be creepin' towards us no longer.

314587.text: The wild provides, but it also devours. Where do you tread?
314587.text1: The wild provides, but it also devours. Where do you tread?

314588.text: Barkskin survive because we honor the mountain, and heed what it says. Are you calm enough inside to listen?
314588.text1: Barkskin survive because we honor the mountain, and heed what it says. Are you calm enough inside to listen?

314595.text: <Felflick's eyes bore into you, an oily grin plastered over sharp teeth.>

314687.text1: <Aisarra looks you over with a subtle nod of her head, but says nothing.>

314852.text: It takes a well-trained mount to navigate Mount Hyjal's squalls.

314897.text1:
Greetings, traveler.

If you are looking to procure supplies from the Guardians of Hyjal, either myself or Aisarra should be able to assist. She can provide tradeskill plans to those who have proven themselves worthy, while I offer other goods that do not require a crafter's expertise.

315463.text: An aging, finely detailed leather scabbard rests on the stone.
315463.text1: An aging, finely detailed leather scabbard rests on the stone.

315614.text1: Every day it's the same thing: Pound this bar, grind this metal. One of these days I'd like a chance to use these axes and hammers in combat! Blacksmithing may be an honorable profession, but there's nothing to get the blood pumping like a real fight.

315623.text1:
<Maruke runs a gentle hand through Dendarro's black fur, and looks up to regard you with curious and defensive eyes.>

Can I help you?

315624.text1:
Thank you, stranger. I would not want Dendarro's last moments to be in pain.

<Maruke's voice wavers slightly.>

Dendarro will...likely not last the night. He is all I have left to remember my mate by.
With his passing, only memories will remain.

<Maruke places a gentle hand on Dendarro. She bows her head, and she blinks back tears.>

Oh, Dazgrul. I am so sorry I could not protect our small family.

315627.text: <Enho looks to be sleeping, but his eyes crack open a fraction as you approach.>

315628.text:
<Enho reaches out a slow, shaky hand to try to take the poultice. He wheezes with the effort and grits his teeth. It is clear he is in immense pain.

He does his best to drink the poultice. After a few small gulps, his features relax slightly as he sighs in relief.

He gives you a weak grunt of thanks, then returns to sleep.>

316103.text: All of Kalimdor gazes upon the peaks of Hyjal. With our guiding hands, we must ensure nature has these pristine snow-packed mountains to drink from for our future, as well.
316103.text1: All of Kalimdor gazes upon the peaks of Hyjal. With our guiding hands, we must ensure nature has these pristine snow-packed mountains to drink from for our future, as well.

316215.text:
The work to rebuild and heal Hyjal begins inside of us. We cannot walk through this summit with poison in the heart, or vengeance on the mind. 

Much energy is spent trying to match the fury of an enemy.

What can we do to unwind old injuries, to help restore this land?
316215.text1:
The work to rebuild and heal Hyjal begins inside of us. We cannot walk through this summit with poison in the heart, or vengeance on the mind. 

Much energy is spent trying to match the fury of an enemy.

What can we do to unwind old injuries, to help restore this land?

316553.text: If this is what we call a victory, it would consume you to know the possible breadth of defeat...
316553.text1: If this is what we call a victory, it would consume you to know the possible breadth of defeat...

316708.text: The remains of a clan should be honored, not trodden upon by demons.
316708.text1: The remains of a clan should be honored, not trodden upon by demons.

316738.text:
<Upon walking up to this raptor, it turns to regard you. This one seems younger than the other two, and does not have scars and scratched scales like its two counterparts. It holds itself a bit higher, perhaps to look more fearsome.

It sways back and forth, clearly brimming with energy and ready to be released into the world. It seems excited about the prospect of having a companion that has an adventurous spirit.

Your adventurous spirit seems to have impressed this raptor, and it will accept you as both a friend and rider.>

316740.text:
<As you approach, the golden eyes of this raptor follow you with a wicked glint. Its nostrils flare and it lets out a grumble. 

Without a second of warning, it lashes out its great tail and smacks the raptor next to it, causing the other creature to roar in displeasure and snap its teeth. The raptor before you looks entirely amused as the one beside it is reprimanded by the handlers. It is clear that this raptor will need a firm hand and a confident rider with its rebellious nature.

It seems pleased when its mischievous personality does not immediately turn you away. It inclines its head toward you, a sign that it will happily bear you as both a friend and a rider.>

316743.text:
<As you approach, this raptor snaps its jaws at you, revealing its long and incredibly sharp teeth. It then growls at you with a challenging gleam in its intelligent eyes. When you do not immediately turn and flee, it looks pleased.

It fixes you with its great golden eyes, and it feels as if it is evaluating you. The raptor taps its long scythe-like talons on the ground in a strange rhythm. With a snort, the raptor lowers its head towards you and clicks its teeth together.

It seems this raptor is impressed by your ferocity and will accept you as both a friend and rider.>

316796.text: Words are like arrows. Once loosed, you cannot call them back.
316796.text1: Words are like arrows. Once loosed, you cannot call them back.

317087.text: Wanna join a battle out in Darkspear Islands?
317087.text1: Wanna join a battle out in Darkspear Islands?

317948.text: Only the most arrogant of fools would try to subjugate nature herself to the yoke of control.
317948.text1: Only the most arrogant of fools would try to subjugate nature herself to the yoke of control.

318504.text1: Need a lift? Our gryphons are always ready to take to the skies.

318589.text1: Do not trouble me, mundane one!

318591.text: In order to change one's station one must be willing to outwit their opponents! Thankfully in this case, demons aren't nearly as clever as we are so that shouldn't be a problem. They are, however, extremely fun to torment.

319174.text: If you need any engineering supplies, I've got you covered.

319607.text:
Greetings, $n. You will have to forgive me for not being able to rise and introduce myself properly. I am still recovering from a recent encounter.

I am Mus'hale, an adventurer much like yourself, with a desire to learn of all the various cultures I encounter on my travels.

320436.text1:
If you've tried to enter Dalaran, you've likely met with the Kirin Tor guards. They are under strict orders not to let outsiders into the city while this disruption runs rampant. The council has decreed that keeping up appearances is more important than preventing a catastrophe.

I suffer no such delusions.

321055.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?
321055.text1:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

322129.text: The panel emits intense heat. The access point has a silvered bowl that is lined with soot and some blackened shards.
322129.text1: The panel emits intense heat. The access point has a silvered bowl that is lined with soot and some blackened shards.

322374.text1: Beautiful here, don't you think? It's taken some time, but we've made quite the home for ourselves.

324570.text:
Excellent. Go to the font where arcane magic is at its strongest. In the absence of proper Highborne sorcerers walking the world freely once more it is your best bet of having the energy required to cleanse the globe after it has rotted for so long.

I have nearly finished poring over the tome you brought me to finish the blade once you have it. Perhaps there is hope yet that we may witness this masterwork in its intended form.

324914.text: The ebb and flow of magic has been disrupted, of late. I hear that even the mages of Dalaran are perplexed. Is this disturbance arcane in nature, or are the elements themselves in unrest?
324914.text1: The ebb and flow of magic has been disrupted, of late. I hear that even the mages of Dalaran are perplexed. Is this disturbance arcane in nature, or are the elements themselves in unrest?

325066.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

325388.text1: If it isn't my--I mean, my follower's underwing! What can the 'Queen of Corvids' do for you, hmm?

325634.text: Apologies, $Gsir:madam;. The bank isn't open yet. Please come back later, if you don't mind.

326954.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?
326954.text1: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

327773.text:
<As you near this saber, it growls menacingly. Its long tail lashes behind it.

It bares its teeth while digging its nails into the soft earth. It would seem its temperament is as stormy as its namesake.

It gently sniffs the air around you, then after a moment, huffs. It seems impressed when you stand your ground.

It seems this saber senses your determination and approves. It will accept you as a worthy rider and champion, should you choose it.>

327777.text1: <The great cat stretches its long, nimble legs as you approach, making no sound with the motion.>

327778.text1:
<The great cat stretches its long, nimble legs as you approach, making no sound with the motion.

It shakes its head, the armor on its body fitting it snugly so as to also be completely silent with its movements.

It watches you closely, as it flexes its sharp claws. This silent saber eyes you and sniffs the air around you.

In a slight bow it inclines its head toward you, impressed with all you have accomplished. It seems to have found you a worthy champion and rider should you choose it.>

327780.text1:
<As you approach, the saber turns its great head to regard you.

Through the glowing visor of its helm, you can feel its piercing eyes evaluating you. It stands stock-still, the rustling of its fur in the gentle Teldrassil wind being the only movement. It almost seems as if it can sense how you have grown, and all the adventures and trials you have overcome.

After a long moment, it lets out a low growl and inclines its armored head.

It would appear this saber has accepted you as both a stalwart champion and confident rider should you choose it.>

327782.text:
<As you walk up to this strider, its tailpipes glimmer and release slightly less dense gas than the ones nearest to it. You hear a whirring sound as it seems to recalibrate its settings in your presence. The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

Mecha-Titanium Eco-strider 9000! Now with elongated wing shields and eco-friendly tailpipe dampers.>

327783.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

H4z4rd Flashdasher 3X 4000. Now with new radiation sensors, and decontamination misters!>

327784.text:
<This strider swivels its head to regard you. A small light on its tailpipe lights up and blinks as you near, then the vents on its neck and legs open to emit a faint mist. The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

H4z4rd Flashdasher 3X 4000. Now with new radiation sensors, and decontamination misters!>

327788.text:
<As you walk up to this ram, it watches you with interest before lowering its head and pointing its horns at you. It gazes steadily at you for a long moment with a challenging snort, then relaxes as recognition flickers in its eyes.

It snorts and shakes the snow from its armored head; its thick ram horns gleam with new nicks and dents from all of the battles it has fought and won since you last met.

This fierce ram seems to sense your determination and approves. It will accept you as its rider and champion.>

327796.text: <The raptor turns to fix you with two vibrant orange eyes.>

327799.text:
<Upon walking up to this kodo, it stands tall and proud next to its kin. Its strong legs cause the earth to shake slightly as it stamps them into the ground. The kodo grunts happily when you near.

It would seem this once timid kodo has found its confidence and is proud of both its strength and fearlessness.
 
It is clear your presence here excites it, and it would be proud to bear you into the grand world as its rider and champion.>

327800.text:
<As you near this kodo, it swivels its powerful neck to regard you, staring you down with keen eyes from under its helmet. It would seem the passage of time has done little to temper its brave and challenging nature.

Long thick scars run the length of its hide and horn. It is clear in your time apart it has become victorious in every battle it has entered against both friend and foe.

As it sizes you up, it relaxes when you don't back down. It seems impressed by your bravery and foes and feats you have overcome in your long journey. It would be proud to bear you as its champion and rider.>

327801.text:
<Nearing this strider, you notice the bird tapping its talons against the moist soil. It stills as you near, perhaps sensing a familiarity about you.

It lets out a soft warble as it regards you, clearly curious about you and the things you have seen since you parted. It seems impressed by all the challenges you have surmounted and the long journey you have been on to get here.

This gentle-natured strider seems fond of you and will happily bear you as its champion and rider.>

327802.text:
<As you approach this strider, the creature lets out a warble and almost seems to bounce with excitement as it recognizes you from before. Even though this strider has matured, it seems it has kept its coloration from the time it was a hatchling, which is unusual.

It stills its agitated movements and fixes you with its golden eyes. After a moment it lets out a gentle warble, clearly impressed at your ability to overcome all that has stood in your path thus far.

After a moment it gently clacks its beak at you, letting out a few more soft warbles. It seems this strider is impressed by your determination and will bear you as its champion and rider.>

327803.text:
<As you near this strider it fixes you with golden eyes, and after a moment it lets out a familiar warble.

This strider has seen more combat since you parted; its legs and beak bear the marks of battle, and its armor shows wear under the polish.

It would seem this adventurous strider approves of you and would delight in traveling to new worlds with you as its champion and rider.>

327804.text: <Even through the visor on its helm, you can feel its gaze as it studies you.>
327804.text1:
<The wolf turns its head to regard you as you draw near. Even through the visor on its helm, you can feel its gaze as it studies you. It sniffs you gently, and after a moment lets out a low but not unfriendly growl in recognition. 

 
It stands up straighter, seemingly to show off the heavy armor adorning its body. The freshly polished metal gleams, even under a coat of Durotar dust kicked up by the hot winds. 

Something within you stirs and you sense that this wolf approves of your bravery and would be proud to bear you as its friend and rider.>

327805.text: <As you approach this wolf it shakes its great head; its armor glints gently against its ashen fur.>

327806.text: <The wolf stands tall and strong, even with the added weight of the armor.>
327806.text1:
<Just as the freshly hewed timbers of a cedar tree fade from red to grey, so too has this timber wolf's fur changed with maturity. Its once boisterous personality is focused, and it stands tall and strong, even with the added weight of the armor. 
 
Its long tail still wags in familiarity as you approach and lets out a knowing whine. Through the glowing enchantment of the helmet's visor, you see its eyes shine with determination; its thirst for adventure is undiminished. 

After a moment it lets out an excited growl. You get the sense that this wolf admires your adventurous spirit and is impressed by all the challenges you have surmounted. It would gladly accept you as a rider and companion.>

327809.text: Oh aye, up in the back of the tavern there's a visitor from Aerie Peak who can probably help you with spiritual guidance or whatever it is that shamans do. Ingol? Ir... Ingrid! That was her name, Ingrid.
327809.text1: Oh aye, up in the back of the tavern there's a visitor from Aerie Peak who can probably help you with spiritual guidance or whatever it is that shamans do. Ingol? Ir... Ingrid! That was her name, Ingrid.

328220.text:
Ah, need a wee trim do ye? It's been a bit fer me as well. I might head that way after my shift!

Ye can find the barber northwest from the entrance to Ironforge.
328220.text1:
Ah, need a wee trim do ye? It's been a bit fer me as well. I might head that way after my shift!

Ye can find the barber northwest from the entrance to Ironforge.

328221.text:
Not to worry, the barbershop just northwest from the entrance to Ironforge.

They'll have ye looking sharp in no time!

328596.text: Huh? What...? Yes... Yes... escaped. I have escaped. Yes... I... I am the King of Stormwind! Varian Wrynn!

328598.text:
What? How dare you! I... well yes of course I am!

Then, the naga hit me... oh she hit me so very hard. Told me I needed to tell them which way the king went...

 I... wait, no, I got away... It was Rupert that was caught. I slipped from the cliffs, into the waters below. I... wait... there was so much blood. Then... darkness.

329302.text: Hidden within their impregnable stronghold of Ironforge mountain, they rarely ventured beyond the wintry peaks of Dun Morogh.

329312.text: Ruled by the child king Anduin Wrynn, the people of Stormwind remain steadfast in their commitment to the Grand Alliance.

329336.text: Scattered across the lands, the wandering tribes were united only by their common hatred for their sworn enemy--the marauding centaur.

329343.text: The vicious trolls that populate the numerous jungle isles of the South Seas are renowned for their cruelty and dark mysticism.

329728.text: <The Wild God lying motionless before you is transparent and incorporeal, as if he is simply... fading away. He shifts slightly as you approach, its glassy eyes following your movement weakly.>

329730.text: Step back, mortal. I will channel magic so that you may see what I saw...

329731.text: No, Ve'han! Do not do this! You are betraying your oath as a protector of the mountain!

329732.text: Oaths are meaningless if those we serve betray us! Know this before you die, lesser god. Our Pact is strong. We will reclaim what was stolen from us!

329734.text: Yes... I can feel it. The power! I can feel the ancient power returning. I am... invincible!

329735.text: I have never seen magic such as this. He absorbed that demigod's power. Invincible indeed...

329736.text: Even a lesser Wild God contains a font of immense energy. No mortal should have this power.

329737.text: Return to Starblaze and tell him what you've learned, little mortal.

329738.text1: As soon as I recover I will take flight for the summit. If I am able, I will find out what became of the other Wild Gods there. Be well, $n.

329786.text1:
<Jereman fall silent for a long moment bows her head.>  

Velician. She was one of the few on this mountain that was a constant voice of reason. One that always sought to find answers when questions arose. I suspect she caught on to the cult long before any of us and went to investigate herself. Which is probably what ultimately led to her demise. 

I... do not know if her spirit will be in the Dream. I do not know what happens to those once their power is taken. I hope she heals and is able to remanifest herself as the rest of us do when we die.
